calibration.note: Nominal 95 %, not calibrated. The locked Monte Carlo validation (hvsr-mc-validation-v1) did not meet its coverage targets: coverage was about 75 % under minute-scale H/V regime changes, and strongly low-frequency-dominated records produced no CI because the default anti-trigger rejects nearly every window. See docs/validation/report-v1.md.

ci_label: Estimated 95% pointwise CI for the selected-window mean

grid.definition: f_i = 10^(i/200) Hz on the anchored logarithmic grid

reasons: no channel sensitivities declared; equal channel gains assumed but not verified

evidence: F3: mean-curve peak 1.92 Hz, prominence ratio 2.84, recurrence 1.00
fundamental candidate: lowest plausible non-source family F3

licensing.third_party_note: Third-party reference datasets, sensor documentation, and template banks keep their own licenses and are not relicensed under CC BY 4.0 by this repository.

tolerance_policy.bootstrap: same seed; derived bounds within the float tolerance
tolerance_policy.scope: same platform and dependency lock; cross-platform bitwise identity is not promised

time_groups.note: halves of the same record are not independent measurements

quality_dimensions.summary_score_reason: No summary score is computed: dimensions are reported separately (D-061).

warnings: peak search starts at 0.2 Hz <= 10/Lw = 0.2 Hz; peaks there cannot pass SESAME reliability criterion (i) (strict inequality). Longer windows are recommended for low frequencies.

bootstrap.conditioning: replicates whose mean curve has a strict local maximum inside family F3
bootstrap.method: peak-replicate-v1: strict local maximum of each replicate mean inside the family band; no realignment

window_peak_frequency_hz.note: dispersion of per-window peaks; not a confidence interval

selections.selection_rule: SDOF R2_log ranking on the 129-point peak-aligned q grid inside the family; global greedy non-overlapping selection; unweighted geometric mean of ORIGINAL spectra

sesame.note: SESAME sigma_A is window dispersion, not the plotted CI.

checks.criterion: exists f- in [f0/4, f0] with A(f) < A0 / 2
exists f+ in [f0, 4 f0] with A(f) < A0 / 2
f_peak[A(f) x/÷ sigma_A(f)] within +/-5 % of f0
sigma_A(f) < theta for 0.5 f0 < f < 2 f0

peaks.sigma_a_definition: exp(sample std of ln A over selected windows); multiplicative factor

source.checksum_note: not verified: the PDF is not fetched at analysis time and no checksum is bundled
source.issuer: SESAME European research project, WP12, Deliverable D23.12
source.title: Guidelines for the implementation of the H/V spectral ratio technique on ambient vibrations: measurements, processing and interpretation

templates.q_grid: x = (i - 64) ln 2 / 64, i = 0..128 (ln(f/fp)), fit band [fp/2, 2 fp]
templates.ranking_order: descending R2_log, then earlier start, then window id
templates.score: R2_log = 1 - SSE/SST in ln amplitude on the q grid (template resemblance, not a quality probability)

uncertainty.calibration_note: Nominal 95 %; coverage not calibrated for this configuration (see Stage 5 validation report).

dependence.estimator: original-time blocks of 2 x Lw anchored at the analyzed start, doubled while adjacent blocks are dependent
dependence.low_power_note: with 17 adjacent block pairs only lag-1 correlations above 0.54 are detectable

uncertainty.interval: expanded percentile (Hesterberg 2015) with k = informative blocks
uncertainty.label: Estimated 95% pointwise CI for the selected-window mean
notes: with 17 adjacent block pairs only lag-1 correlations above 0.54 are detectable
block-length sensitivity not estimable at factor(s) [2.0] (< 10 blocks)
uncertainty.resampling_unit: whole window spectra (all frequencies jointly), ln-amplitude averaging

window_dispersion.label: Window-to-window dispersion (sample std of ln H/V); describes variability, not the uncertainty of the mean

units.ci: same units as hv; bounds of the selected-window geometric mean
units.window_start_samples: samples from the first canonical sample
